name: italix/i18n
description: Translation and formatting on ICU: CLDR plural categories, locale-aware numbers, money and dates, URL slugs in the language of the URL, and a key extractor that refuses to guess

suggest.ext-intl: Uses ICU directly when present. Without it the portable engine reads tables baked from ICU, covering the 24 official EU languages for plurals, numbers, money and dates — and refusing collation, spellout and display names rather than approximating them.
